Six study days, then a catch-up day, seven times over, then the capstone. Every catch-up day is a Sunday and is deliberately unallocated — if you are on track, the day is yours.

Paused after day 2 (Sat 25 Jul) and resumed at day 3 on Wednesday, 19 August 2026.
